xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4474: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 3): host WebRTC hub, content wire format and conversation bridge

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 3): host WebRTC hub, content wire format and conversation bridge
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Slice 2 lets a host create a share and admit viewers, but nothing flows after admission: the host ignores the signal and ice-servers frames the share service relays, no peer connection exists, and there is no wire format for content. Slice 4 (viewer surface) cannot start until the host side opens data channels, speaks a defined wire format and streams the shared conversation.
narratives.Proposal: Add the content wire format types to packages/contracts/src/sharing.ts and its runtime (allow-list mapping, envelope decode, fragmentation, seq gap detection, hello negotiation) to a new sharing-wire.ts. Under src/dashboard/server/sharing/ add ChannelWriter (ordered, fragmenting, backpressured sends), ConversationBridge (full-history backfill via the claude-initial parser, then append/update from watchConversation) and PeerHub (one werift RTCPeerConnection per eligible viewer, five labelled channels, host offers, ICE servers from the share service, content gated on the host's own admitted set, hello then conversation and presence content). Wire the hub into ShareManager (signal/ice-servers routing, admit/kick/revoke notifications, close on drop). Prove it with fake-peer unit tests, a werift loopback test and a Miniflare test through the real share Worker; run the werift spike including Chromium interop and record it in the parent PRD; document it in docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md and docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4474.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The viewer side: join intent, viewer join socket, browser RTCPeerConnection, /#/shared/<roomId>, rendering (slice 4, PAN-4475)
- Any content on drafts (slice 5) or terminal (slice 6); inbound handling on any channel other than control
- Control-channel commands beyond hello (send-prompt, handoff, acks) and controller enforcement (slices 5 and 7)
- Host socket reconnect, re-park after restart, seeding the host-admitted set from a snapshot, renegotiation after re-park (slice 8, PAN-4479)
- pan share / pan join (slice 9), the hosted web join (slice 10), forced-TURN verification and the signaling-privacy e2e (slice 11)
- Sharing the work log, tool calls, thinking, plans, cost or context usage; populating SharedMessage.author
- Streaming non-Claude harness transcripts or subagent transcripts, or detecting a non-Claude conversation with a transcriptKind/harness comparison
- Progressive or windowed history; history is one history payload
- Adding @roamhq/wrtc, reordering TURN URLs for werift, or changing src/lib/anywhere/
- New src/lib/errors.ts tags, an Effect-native rewrite, or any change to services/share/, routes/shares.ts, ws-rpc.ts, the frontend, or scripts/*-baseline.txt and allowlists
- Deploying anything

autoDecisions.summary: werift 0.25.1 stays the host WebRTC stack; the spike measures and records rather than chooses (D-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: werift is already a production dependency running Anywhere's data channels; 5 MB/s is a ~1000x margin over a shared conversation's rate, and @roamhq/wrtc would break bun dev mode (parent NFR-5). Only a Chromium interop failure escalates, via pan tell.

autoDecisions.summary: Forced-TURN is not re-verified in this slice (D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Agents hold no TURN credentials; werift's TURN client already runs Anywhere's relay route; slice 11 (PAN-4482) owns forced-TURN verification for sharing.

autoDecisions.summary: Runtime wire helpers go in a new packages/contracts/src/sharing-wire.ts; sharing.ts stays type-only (D-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent D-R3-8 keeps sharing.ts import-free for the Worker; slice 4's browser needs the same decoder, so contracts is the shared home.

autoDecisions.summary: The hello is wrapped in a control envelope, the viewer echoes the host's scope, and content waits for the viewer's hello (D-4, D-5, D-6).
autoDecisions.rationale: One decoder for every message; the viewer cannot know the scope before the host's hello; waiting gives a future host the viewer's version before choosing a format.

autoDecisions.summary: Generic fragmentation at 32,768 characters per data-channel message, one history envelope, 32 Mi character cap (D-8).
autoDecisions.rationale: Browsers advertise a 256 KiB max-message-size; one fragmentation rule also covers a single huge append; the parent PRD defers progressive history.

autoDecisions.summary: No transcriptKind/harness check anywhere and no ws-rpc.ts extraction; the bridge mirrors ws-rpc's Claude session resolution without a file-existence check (D-11).
autoDecisions.rationale: scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh fails any new transcriptKind comparison in a file without a baseline row; a fresh conversation's JSONL appears only after its first prompt and the watcher already polls for it.

autoDecisions.summary: The host-admitted set is fed only by the host's own admit/kick/revoke commands; snapshots can only remove absent ids (D-12).
autoDecisions.rationale: This is the parent PRD's NFR-4 defense in depth; removing on a lobby state would race an in-flight admit.

autoDecisions.summary: A dropped host socket keeps established peers; the hub closes only when the host entry is dropped (D-15).
autoDecisions.rationale: Content is peer-to-peer and slice 2 never reconnects; slice 8 owns reconnect. Viewers tear down on their own 4004.

autoDecisions.summary: Presence follows the parent PRD's PresencePayload but with numeric GitHub ids and never sends connected or blocked (D-17).
autoDecisions.rationale: RoomSnapshot uses numbers; the block list is controller-only information.

autoDecisions.summary: Plain async classes with injected seams; no new src/lib/errors.ts tags; new modules under src/dashboard/server/sharing/ (D-19, D-20).
autoDecisions.rationale: Inherits slice 2's D-8/D-9 (one-variant-per-operation rule); the issue names the sharing/ path.

autoDecisions.summary: Work log, tool calls and thinking are not shared; SharedMessage is the whole allow-list (D-21).
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD's wire format lists SharedMessage only.

narrative.Action: WI-4 of .pan/drafts/PAN-4474.md. Create src/dashboard/server/sharing/channel-writer.ts per the 'Channel writer' section: WRITER_HIGH_WATER_BYTES (1 MiB), WRITER_LOW_WATER_BYTES (256 KiB), WRITER_MAX_QUEUED_CHARS (64 Mi), the WritableDataChannel interface, and ChannelWriter (send encodes with encodeSharedMessage and a per-writer chunk id counter, FIFO queue, flush while open and bufferedAmount <= high water, one bufferedAmountLow subscription while waiting, onOverflow once, close).
